info.description: REST API for the Too Good To Go application.
info.title: Too Good To Go API

get.description: Filters stores by status, category, city, and accepts_orders. Deleted stores are excluded unless include_deleted=true. Limit defaults to 20 and is capped at 50.

parameters.description: Search store name, slug, city, or owner
parameters.name: search

patch.description: Updates store profile and accepts_orders. Ownership, approval status, and computed fields are ignored.

get.description: Lists orders for a store, optionally filtered by status (use "active" for pending_payment, paid, ready).

patch.description: Toggles whether a store is active and accepting orders.

get.description: Returns the store's current subscription plan, commission rate, period, remaining days, and upgrade request.

Stores newest submitted first, with filters and page-number pagination. total counts the filtered stores; counts counts every store per status, ignoring the filters. Approval is per store, so a "vendor" here is a store.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of store name, owner name, category or address (max 100 characters)
parameters.name: search

post.description: pending -> approved. The store can then publish offers and is shown to customers. No body.

409.description: CONFLICT: not pending, or changed meanwhile

post.description: suspended -> approved; the decision is cleared. No body.

409.description: CONFLICT: not suspended, or changed meanwhile

post.description: pending -> rejected (final). reason_code: unverifiable_address, invalid_owner_info, invalid_contact, missing_documents, ineligible_category, other. message: 20-500 characters, shown to the vendor.

409.description: CONFLICT: not pending, or changed meanwhile

post.description: approved -> suspended. Its offers stop being publishable and visible. Existing paid orders stay valid and must be fulfilled. reason_code: customer_complaints, missed_pickups, frequent_cancellations, expired_license, policy_violation, unpaid_balance, vendor_request, other. message: 20-500 characters.

409.description: CONFLICT: not approved, or changed meanwhile

get.summary: Identity from the access token (any authenticated role)

403.description: FORBIDDEN: the account is suspended, deleted or has no role

post.description: Sends an OTP by SMS to the phone number. The code is never returned, except as debug_code when OTP_EXPOSE_CODE is enabled outside production.
Checks the code and consumes it on success, then logs the user in (creating the account on first login) and returns a JWT access token. A malformed code is rejected without using up an attempt.
post.summary: Verify a one-time password and log in

403.description: FORBIDDEN: the account is suspended or deleted

get.description: لیست علاقه‌مندی‌ها، جدیدترین اول. فقط آفرهایی که همین الان قابل خرید هستند نمایش داده می‌شوند.

put.description: افزودن به علاقه‌مندی. idempotent است: تکرار درخواست خطا نمی‌دهد. {id} همان public id آفر است. آفر ناشناس یا غیرقابل‌نمایش ۴۰۴ می‌دهد.

delete.description: حذف از علاقه‌مندی. idempotent است و همیشه ۲۰۴ برمی‌گرداند (وجود یا عدم وجود آفر لو نمی‌رود).

get.description: 200 when the service and all its dependencies are healthy, 503 otherwise (including during shutdown).
دسته‌بندی‌های صفحه اصلی.
آخرین فرصت‌های نجات غذا: حداکثر ۳ عدد باقی‌مانده یا پایان بازه تحویل تا ۲ ساعت دیگر؛ زودترین پایان اول.
محبوب‌های اطراف شما: داخل شعاع، بیشترین علاقه‌مندی اول، سپس نزدیک‌ترین. بدون lat/lng لیست خالی برمی‌گردد (نه خطا).
فرصت‌های خوشمزه امروز: آفرهایی که بازه تحویل‌شان امروز (به وقت تهران) شروع می‌شود؛ بیشترین تخفیف اول. هر بار ۱۰ مورد؛ برای «مشاهده همه» next_cursor را به عنوان cursor بفرستید.

کاتالوگ آفرها با جستجو، فیلتر، مرتب‌سازی و pagination (cursor). فقط آفرهای قابل خرید نمایش داده می‌شوند. اگر sort ارسال نشود: با lat/lng نزدیک‌ترین، وگرنه جدیدترین. با تغییر فیلتر یا sort باید cursor را از اول شروع کرد.

parameters.description: Search text (offer title or store name)
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: RFC3339: delivery window must end after this instant
parameters.name: pickup_from

parameters.description: RFC3339: delivery window must start before this instant
parameters.name: pickup_to

parameters.description: Hide offers containing ANY of these
parameters.name: exclude_allergens

parameters.description: Only offers within this radius (needs lat & lng)
parameters.name: radius_km

get.description: گزینه‌های فیلتر: تب‌ها، دسته‌ها، آلرژن‌ها، بازه قیمت آفرهای فعال و گزینه‌های مرتب‌سازی.
آفرهای اطراف برای نقشه، نزدیک‌ترین اول. lat و lng اجباری است. برای یک پین به ازای هر فروشگاه، سمت کلاینت روی store.id گروه‌بندی کنید.
جزئیات کامل آفر برای صفحه محصول شامل اطلاعات آفر و فروشگاه، قیمت، بازه تحویل، آلرژن‌ها و موجودی فعلی. همان قوانین انتشار و دسترس‌پذیری کاتالوگ اعمال می‌شود.

Order history of the signed-in user, newest first, with cursor pagination. Only the caller's own orders are returned. upcoming = pending_payment, paid, ready; past = completed, cancelled, expired, no_show. An empty history is 200 with an empty list.

parameters.description: Comma-separated statuses, e.g. completed,cancelled. Combined with group, only statuses in both apply.
parameters.name: status

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: invalid group, status, limit or cursor

403.description: FORBIDDEN: the account is suspended, deleted or has no role

post.description: Creates a customer reservation with atomic inventory decrement. Supply an Idempotency-Key header to make repeated submissions safe; replaying the same key with the same payload returns the existing reservation (200), while reusing it with different parameters returns 409.

parameters.description: Optional idempotency key for safe retries
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: Idempotent replay of an existing reservation

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: invalid offer_id, quantity, terms_accepted or Idempotency-Key

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: missing or invalid bearer token

409.description: CONFLICT: offer unavailable, insufficient stock, or idempotency key parameter mismatch

get.description: Returns public store information, schedule, and available food offers for eligible stores. Unknown or unavailable stores return 404 without exposing private fields.
get.summary: Get public store details and available offers

get.description: Returns dashboard metrics, reservation counts by status, today's activity (Asia/Tehran), financial overview, nearest active reservation, pending store applications, and recent reservations scoped strictly to stores owned by the authenticated vendor.

parameters.description: Optional UUID of an owned store to narrow the summary
parameters.name: store_id

404.description: NOT_FOUND: store not found or not owned by vendor

get.description: Lists orders and reservations for the vendor's active store with filtering by date and status, and pagination.

parameters.description: Filter by order status: all, active, ready_for_pickup, delivered, cancelled
parameters.name: status

get.description: Aggregates daily order count, active reservations count, delivered count and total revenue for the vendor.
Retrieves detailed information for a specific vendor order.

patch.description: Transitions a vendor order to ready_for_pickup (ready), cancelled (restores offer inventory), or no_show. Enforces store ownership and valid state transitions.

post.description: Marks an order as delivered/completed after checking pickup code and vendor store ownership.

get.description: Retrieves store information for the active store of the authenticated vendor.
Retrieves all store creation/branch requests submitted by the authenticated vendor.

post.description: Submits a request to create a new store or branch.

get.description: Retrieves status and details of a store creation request.
Retrieves all stores owned by the authenticated vendor.
Retrieves store information for a store owned by the authenticated vendor.

patch.description: Updates editable fields (name, pickup address, category, phone, biography, instructions, working hours, images, location) for a store owned by the authenticated vendor.
